sql: SELECT course_id, student_id FROM registration WHERE grade IS NULL OR grade = ''
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM prof
SELECT S.f_name, S.l_name, R.capability, S.gpa FROM RA R JOIN student S ON S.student_id = R.student_id JOIN prof P ON P.prof_id = R.prof_id WHERE P.first_name = 'Merwyn' AND P.last_name = 'Conkay'
SELECT S.f_name, S.l_name, R.capability FROM RA R JOIN student S ON S.student_id = R.student_id JOIN prof P ON P.prof_id = R.prof_id WHERE P.graduate_from = 'University of Washington'

SELECT T3.name, T3.credit FROM RA T1 JOIN prof T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id JOIN registration T4 ON T4.student_id = T1.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T3.course_id = T4.course_id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' AND T2.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof WHERE gender = 'Female')
SELECT R.capability FROM RA R JOIN student S ON S.student_id = R.student_id WHERE S.type = 'RPG' AND S.intelligence >= 4
SELECT COUNT(S.student_id) FROM registration G JOIN student S ON S.student_id = G.student_id WHERE G.grade = 'B' AND S.intelligence = 3
SELECT C.name FROM course C JOIN registration G ON G.course_id = C.course_id WHERE G.grade = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(S.student_id) FROM RA R JOIN student S ON S.student_id = R.student_id WHERE R.salary = 'low' AND S.gpa = 3.5
SELECT CAST(SUM(sat) AS REAL) / COUNT(course_id) FROM registration WHERE grade = 'B'
SELECT S.f_name, S.l_name, C.name FROM student S JOIN registration G ON G.student_id = S.student_id JOIN course C ON C.course_id = G.course_id WHERE S.intelligence = 5 AND S.gpa < 3
SELECT AVG(R.capability) FROM RA R JOIN student S ON S.student_id = R.student_id WHERE S.gpa < 2.5
SELECT S.f_name, S.l_name, R.capability FROM student S JOIN RA R ON S.student_id = R.student_id JOIN registration G ON G.student_id = S.student_id WHERE G.grade IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(R.student_id) FROM RA R JOIN prof P ON P.prof_id = R.prof_id WHERE R.salary = 'high' AND P.teachingability = (SELECT MAX(teachingability) FROM prof)

SELECT COUNT(S.student_id) FROM student S JOIN registration G ON G.student_id = S.student_id JOIN course C ON C.course_id = G.course_id WHERE C.name = 'Statistical Learning' AND G.sat = 4 AND S.gpa = 3.8
SELECT COUNT(S.student_id) FROM student S JOIN registration G ON G.student_id = S.student_id JOIN course C ON C.course_id = G.course_id WHERE C.diff = 3 AND S.intelligence = 2
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN S.type = 'UG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN S.type = 'RPG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM RA R JOIN student S ON S.student_id = R.student_id WHERE R.capability < 3
